meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: 装上后,它会注册 GitHub 渠道,让机器人能接收 PR 和 Issue 评论事件。评论里精确 @ 机器人时,它回帖,并把同一 PR/Issue 线程当作独立对话继续跟进。
howto.when: 配好独立机器人账号、仓库 webhook 和环境变量后,当 GitHub 发来 Issue comments 或 Pull request review comments,且评论精确 @ 机器人用户名时触发;随后该线程的后续评论也会被处理。

say.text: 帮我把 GitHub 接进来,让机器人能被 @ 并回复 PR/Issue 评论
私有仓库用 public 策略接 GitHub,把通道连到我的 agent 组
GitHub 评论没触发回复,帮我检查 webhook 和机器人用户名
say.note: 先跑注册测试,再核对凭据、事件和用户名。

howto.what_en: Adds a GitHub channel via the Chat SDK: the adapter is copied and registered so the agent joins PR and issue comment threads. It replies when exactly @-mentioned and keeps that thread as one ongoing conversation.
howto.when_en: Fires on GitHub issue-comment/PR-review-comment events that @-mention the exact bot username (bot, webhooks, and env vars preconfigured). Follow-up comments are handled too.

say_en.text: Connect GitHub so the bot can be @-mentioned and reply in PR/issue comments
say_en.note: Walks through adapter setup and configuration.

say_en.text: Wire GitHub for a private repo using the public policy to my agent group
say_en.note: Creates the messaging group and wiring.

say_en.text: GitHub comments aren't triggering. Check webhook events and exact bot username
say_en.note: Checks the test, credentials, events, and mention.
